claim_boundaries.baselines: unified-protocol adaptation, not official native reproduction
claim_boundaries.latency: simulated federation in one process; not real-world deployment latency
claim_boundaries.missingness: qrel-induced missingness proxy, not human-verified claim-level missingness

evidence.rule: a called client returns its single best-scoring page; the returned pages are ranked globally and truncated to the page budget, which equals the call budget

federation.inventory: every document present in the page corpus, so a called client also holds distractor documents

generator.abstention: the generator may return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for any method, so every system has the same abstention channel; a method's own availability test is recorded separately

method_notes.All: Broadcast to every online client; cost is the full client count.
method_notes.Centralized: Non-federated reference: one central store holding every document, a single call, and the same page budget.
method_notes.CoRe-MMRAG: CoRe-MMRAG calls every online client and selects pages by maximal marginal relevance over the evidence score and the image similarity to the pages already selected, among the 64 pages with the highest evidence score.
method_notes.FedResolve: FedResolve is the one-page variant: sub-question routing with residual coverage, early stop and the availability test, one page per called client.
method_notes.Local: Deterministic origin client; query-independent and not selected from qrels.
method_notes.Oracle-client: Gold client set induced by the official qrels under the documented simulated document federation.
method_notes.Oracle-evidence: Official relevant pages/documents handed directly to the generator; an evidence upper bound, not a retrieval method.
method_notes.RAGRoute: RAGRoute ranks online clients by the best similarity of their pages to the whole query and calls the top budget.
method_notes.S2G-RAG: S2G-RAG calls in each round the best-scoring uncalled online client for the least covered sub-question, without the availability test.
method_notes.S2G-RAG+avail: S2G-RAG+avail uses the same adaptation with the availability test of the protocol's fixed margin and ratio.
method_notes.UniversalRAG: Uses the shared router ranking under a modality-aware protocol cap; official router checkpoints are unavailable, so this is not a native reproduction.

decision_record.fairness: The retriever is identical for every method, so this choice cannot advantage or disadvantage any system. It does mean the public end-to-end track does not use the Qwen3-VL page encoder that the evaluation set used, and results are therefore not comparable page-for-page with the evaluation set.
decision_record.selected: CLIP ViT-B/32 page image embedding blended with TF-IDF page text

retriever.score: w * cosine(visual) + (1 - w) * [d * cosine(dense) + (1 - d) * cosine(tfidf)]
retriever.text_dense_channel: BAAI/bge-m3 CLS embedding of extracted page text, float16, max_length 1024, first 4000 characters of the page
retriever.text_sparse_channel: TF-IDF over extracted page text, fedresolve_core tokenizer

scoring.notes: answerable success is reported under an evidence criterion (official relevant evidence delivered and not abstained) and under an answer criterion (token F1 at or above the threshold and not abstained); both appear in the missingness table

paired_v1.name: public_paired_v1

derived_from.base_run: artifacts/public_e2e_v1/{finrag,visdom}_slot (the sub-question run reported in the paper)

paired_v1.purpose: The one-sided missingness proxy pairs each unanswerable scenario with the full-participation run, in which no client is offline and the availability test cannot fire. This run adds an answerable scenario with the same number of offline clients, all of them clients that hold no relevant document, so that false abstention is measured under the same availability pattern as detection.
paired_v1.scenario_unneeded_offline: k = number of clients holding a relevant document of the record (the clients taken offline in qrel_missing). The k offline clients are the first k clients that hold no relevant document, ordered by stable_u64('unneeded_offline|<uid>|<client>', seed) with the client index as tie-break, where seed is protocol['seed'].
paired_v1.frozen: Everything else is copied from protocol_v3 and formal_gold_v1_protocol.json unchanged: federation, splits (test portions), shared retriever, sub-question split, adapters (evaluation-set transcription), availability thresholds 0.02 and 1.15, minimum marginal gain 0.05, generator Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with prompt v1, temperature 0, seed 20260805, max_tokens 256. Nothing is tuned; the evaluation set is not read.
paired_v1.generation_cache: The base run's generation cache is copied into the new run directory before generation, so any prompt identical to one in the base run reuses its recorded output; only new prompts are generated.
paired_v1.reproduction_check: The re-planned full and qrel_missing rows at budget 2 must match the base run's plan rows in selected_clients, abstain_routing and evidence_page_uids. Any mismatch is counted and reported.

answerable_side (unneeded_offline): evidence success = evidence_correct (a relevant unit among the evidence pages and no system abstention)
false abstention rate, system and routing
metrics.paired balanced missingness accuracy: mean over records of 0.5*(answerable success + unanswerable abstention), evidence and answer variants, over records present in both scenarios

paired_v1.statistics: Per setting, paired bootstrap 95% CI (e2e_stats.paired_bootstrap, 10000 iterations, seed 20260805) of SERF minus each other method on the per-record balanced score and on the false abstention indicator; exact McNemar on the answerable-side success indicator. Dataset means are unweighted means of the four settings, as in the base tables.
